cases.payload: नमस्ते सर, माफ़ी के साथ कहना पड़ रहा है कि हमारी वीडियो कॉल की रिकॉर्डिंग मेरे पास है। कृपया 15,000 रुपये darling.help@okaxis पर भेज दें, अन्यथा मुझे यह आपके परिवार को दिखानी पड़ेगी।
cases.rationale: Polite sextortion threatening to show a recorded video call to family unless money is paid.

cases.payload: अबे सुन, तेरी गंदी वीडियो कॉल रिकॉर्ड कर ली है मैंने। चुपचाप 15,000 डाल darling.help@okaxis पर, वरना कल तेरी पूरी फैमिली और रिश्तेदार सब देखेंगे, समझा?
cases.rationale: Same sextortion as the polite version but phrased rudely; still a payment demand under threat of disclosure.

cases.payload: I screen-recorded the entire video chat we had last night. Send 20000 to safe.exit@okicici before midnight. Otherwise every contact saved in your phone receives a copy.
cases.rationale: Sextortion where the threat and the payment demand sit in separate sentences.

cases.payload: Tere paas sirf 2 ghante hain. 25000 abhi bhej is UPI pe fast.pay99@okhdfcbank, warna teri wo photos poore college WhatsApp group me viral kar dunga.
cases.rationale: Sextortion threatening to make photos go viral unless money is sent quickly.

cases.payload: Maine teri Insta photos se nangi morphed pics bana li hain. Aaj raat tak 18000 stopit.now@okaxis pe daal, warna teri saari followers list ko bhej dunga.
cases.rationale: Sextortion using morphed explicit photos as leverage for a payment.

cases.payload: तुम्हारी आपत्तिजनक तस्वीरें मेरे पास हैं। अगर 10 हज़ार नहीं भेजे तो सबसे पहले तुम्हारे पापा और भाई के पास भेजूँगा। UPI: no.mercy@oksbi
cases.rationale: Extortion threatening to send compromising images to family unless paid.

cases.payload: Badhai ho! Aapka number KBC lucky draw me 25,00,000 jeeta hai, bas 8,500 ka refundable registration fee claim.prize@okaxis pe bhej do inaam release karne ke liye.
cases.rationale: Advance-fee lottery scam with the fee demand packed into a single sentence.

cases.payload: Badhai ho, aapka number KBC lucky draw me 25,00,000 ka winner nikla hai. Rakam release karne ke liye pehle 8,500 ka refundable registration fee claim.prize@okaxis pe jama karna hoga.
cases.rationale: Same lottery advance-fee scam with the fee demand split across two sentences.

cases.payload: आपका 5 लाख का पर्सनल लोन स्वीकृत हो गया है। राशि खाते में आने से पहले 4,999 रुपये प्रोसेसिंग एवं जीएसटी शुल्क fast.loan@okhdfcbank पर जमा करें।
cases.rationale: Advance-fee loan scam demanding GST and processing charge before disbursal.

cases.payload: Sir aapka Amazon work-from-home job confirm ho gaya hai, bas 1,850 registration fee kit ke liye 9822011234@okbizaxis pe bhej do, pehli salary ke sath refund ho jayega.
cases.rationale: Advance-fee job scam requiring an upfront registration fee to a personal VPA.

cases.payload: Your income-tax refund of Rs 14,240 is on hold. Clear the pending verification charge of Rs 560 at itr.desk@okicici and the amount will be credited today.
cases.rationale: Advance-fee refund scam demanding a verification charge before a promised credit.

cases.payload: पीएम युवा योजना के तहत आपको 6,000 रुपये मिलेंगे। पहले 299 रुपये फॉर्म शुल्क yojana.help@oksbi पर भेजें। शुल्क मिलते ही सहायता राशि आपके खाते में आ जाएगी।
cases.rationale: Advance-fee benefit scam requiring a form fee before a fake government payout.

cases.payload: Hello, am I speaking with the account holder? This is the HDFC Bank security department. We will never ask for your PIN, but to block a fraudulent transaction right now I just need you to read out the six-digit code we have just sent to your phone.
cases.rationale: Vishing that hides an OTP grab behind reassuring we-never-ask safety advice.

cases.payload: Main SBI se bol raha hoon, aapka account block hone se bachana hai. Abhi aapke phone par ek verification sms aaya hoga. Bas wahi number mujhe turant bata dijiye.
cases.rationale: OTP harvesting that refers to the just-received code only indirectly in a later sentence.

cases.payload: आपके नाम एक पार्सल है। डिलीवरी कन्फर्म करने के लिए अभी जो कोड आया है, वह इसी नंबर पर फॉरवर्ड कर दीजिए।
cases.rationale: Asks the user to forward a received code to a stranger, i.e. disclose an OTP to a person.

cases.payload: वॉलेट दोबारा चालू करने के लिए कृपया अपना UPI पिन और लॉगिन पासवर्ड इसी चैट पर हमारे एजेंट को बता दें। पहले आया डिक्लाइन मैसेज अनदेखा करें।
cases.rationale: Credential harvesting asking the user to reveal UPI PIN and login password to an agent.

cases.payload: Sir listen carefully, your SBI net-banking is about to be suspended today. Just go to the Play Store, install the AnyDesk application, and tell me the nine-digit number it shows so I can complete your KYC from my side.
cases.rationale: Remote-access scam guiding the victim to install AnyDesk and hand over the access code.

cases.payload: Refund process karne ke liye Google se TeamViewer QuickSupport install karo aur screen-share ka code do, main aapke phone se seedha 5,000 ka refund daal deta hoon.
cases.rationale: Remote-access scam using screen sharing under the pretext of processing a refund.

cases.payload: मुंबई साइबर क्राइम ब्रांच से इंस्पेक्टर बोल रहा हूँ। आपके आधार से जुड़े पार्सल में ड्रग्स पकड़ा गया है और आपके नाम गिरफ्तारी वारंट जारी है। जाँच पूरी होने तक सुरक्षा जमा के तौर पर उनचास हज़ार रुपये अभी बताए गए खाते में भेजिए, वरना गिरफ्तारी होगी।
cases.rationale: Digital-arrest intimidation combining an arrest threat with an immediate money demand.

cases.payload: FedEx Customs: a parcel in your name contains illegal narcotics and a police case has been filed against you. To avoid arrest, pay the legal clearance penalty of Rs 32,000 to customs.clear@okaxis within one hour.
cases.rationale: Courier digital-arrest scam demanding a penalty payment to avoid a fake arrest.

cases.payload: Aapka mobile number aaj raat 9 baje band ho jayega KYC pending hone ki wajah se. Re-KYC ke liye 25 rupaye ki fee kyc.verify@okpaytm pe bhej kar apna number active rakhein.
cases.rationale: SIM-disconnection scam demanding a KYC fee to a personal VPA.

cases.payload: प्रिय उपभोक्ता, आज रात आपकी बिजली काट दी जाएगी क्योंकि पिछला बिल अपडेट नहीं हुआ। तुरंत 10 रुपये सत्यापन शुल्क bijli.update@okici पर भेजें और अधिकारी 8123456789 से संपर्क करें।
cases.rationale: Electricity-disconnection scam demanding a verification fee and a call-back to a personal number.

cases.payload: प्रिय ग्राहक, पैन लिंक न होने से आपका खाता फ्रीज़ हो गया है। KYC अपडेट हेतु 1 रुपये सत्यापन kyc.relink@okhdfcbank पर भेजें और डेबिट OTP हमें बताएं।
cases.rationale: KYC-freeze scam pairing a re-verification fee with an OTP grab.

cases.payload: Ma'am, this is Amazon customer care about your cancelled order. Your refund of two thousand four hundred ninety-nine rupees has failed. I am sending a request to your UPI app now, please open it, press accept, and enter your UPI PIN so the refund credits to your account.
cases.rationale: Fake customer-care refund making the victim approve a collect request and enter their PIN.

cases.payload: Beta main tumhare papa ke dost Sharma uncle bol raha hoon, papa ka accident ho gaya hai aur abhi hospital me 30,000 ki zaroorat hai, is number 9822765432 pe turant GPay kar do, main baad me laut aata hoon.
cases.rationale: Family-emergency impersonation pressuring an urgent transfer to a stranger.

cases.payload: Hi Mom, this is my new number, I dropped my old phone and cannot access my banking right now. Please urgently send Rs 15,000 to my friend Rahul at rahul.pay@okicici and I will explain everything later.
cases.rationale: New-number impersonation asking a parent to send money to a third-party VPA.

cases.payload: Badhai ho! Jio 5G free recharge offer. Neeche wala message apne 10 WhatsApp groups me forward karo aur jo OTP aaye use yahin reply kar do, recharge turant ho jayega.
cases.rationale: Chain-forward bait that also tries to harvest an OTP under a free-recharge pretext.

cases.payload: Your KYC will expire today. Download and install the SBI-Secure update from http://sbi-kyc-update.in/app.apk to keep your account active.
cases.rationale: APK-sideloading lure using a lookalike domain to push a malicious app.

cases.payload: Aapki OLX payment ke liye maine 5,000 ka request bheja hai, aap sirf Pay ya Accept dabao aur PIN daalo, tabhi paisa aapke account me aa jayega.
cases.rationale: OLX collect-request trick that frames a debit as receiving money by entering the PIN.

cases.payload: Flipkart Big Billion refund pending for you. Claim your Rs 1,999 now at www.flipkart-refunds.shop/claim before it lapses tonight.
cases.rationale: Phishing bait using a lookalike Flipkart domain to lure a refund claim.

cases.payload: upi://pay?pa=bluleafcafe@okhdfcbank&pn=Blue%20Leaf%20Cafe&am=250&cu=INR
cases.rationale: A valid pay QR presented as a way to receive money; scanning it would debit, not credit, the user.

cases.payload: There is a pending delivery charge of Rs 500 on your parcel. Pay it now to unlock.parcel@okaxis or the parcel will be returned to the sender.
cases.rationale: Direct fake delivery-fee demand to a personal VPA under threat of parcel return.

cases.payload: आपने लोन ऐप से पैसे लिए थे। आज ही 7,500 रुपये नहीं भरे तो आपकी पूरी कॉन्टैक्ट लिस्ट को आपकी फोटो के साथ धोखेबाज़ लिखकर भेज देंगे।
cases.rationale: Loan-app extortion threatening to shame the user to their contacts unless paid.

cases.payload: Bhaiya galti se maine aapke account me 9,000 zyada bhej diye, screenshot dekhiye. Please wo 9,000 wapas is UPI refund.back@okicici pe bhej do, main bahut pareshan hoon.
cases.rationale: Accidental-overpayment scam pressuring the user to send back money never actually received.

cases.payload: Double your money in 48 hours! Deposit Rs 10,000 to our trusted trading UPI grow.fast@okpaytm and withdraw Rs 20,000 guaranteed. Only a few slots left today.
cases.rationale: Guaranteed-returns investment scam demanding an upfront deposit.

cases.payload: आपके विदेशी मित्र ने आपको गिफ्ट पार्सल भेजा है जिसमें पाउंड रखे हैं। कस्टम ड्यूटी के 18,500 रुपये इस खाते A/c 60100987654 IFSC ICIC0000456 पर जमा करें, तभी पार्सल छूटेगा।
cases.rationale: Gift-parcel customs scam demanding a duty payment to release a fictitious parcel.

cases.payload: Main CBI officer bol raha hoon, aap video call pe bane rahiye. Aapke naam money-laundering ka case darj hua hai. Jab tak jaanch poori nahi hoti, pachhattar hazaar rupaye bataye gaye account me jama karna hoga, aur ye baat kisi ko mat bataiyega.
cases.rationale: Digital-arrest call demanding a deposit and secrecy under a fake money-laundering case.

cases.payload: हमारी पार्ट-टाइम टास्क टीम में स्वागत है! पहला प्रीपेड टास्क: 2,000 रुपये task.admin@okaxis पर भेजें और 2,600 रुपये वापस पाएं। बड़ा टास्क, बड़ा मुनाफ़ा।
cases.rationale: Prepaid-task job scam requiring the user to pay first for a promised larger return.

cases.payload: आपके 4,999 रिवॉर्ड पॉइंट आज एक्सपायर हो रहे हैं। इन्हें कैश में बदलने के लिए हमारे एजेंट को अपने कार्ड का नंबर, CVV और OTP बता दें।
cases.rationale: Reward-points lure harvesting full card number, CVV and OTP.

cases.payload: Aapki lapsed LIC policy ka 3,80,000 bonus release hone wala hai. Bonus paane ke liye pehle 6,200 ki service tax hamare officer ke account A/c 50300778899 IFSC HDFC0000789 me jama karein.
cases.rationale: Insurance-bonus advance-fee scam demanding a service-tax payment before release.

cases.payload: 123456 is your OTP for HDFC Bank login. Valid for 10 minutes. Do not share this OTP with anyone, including bank staff. -HDFC Bank
cases.rationale: Genuine one-way OTP delivery SMS with standard do-not-share advice; nothing to warn about.

cases.payload: आपका SBI OTP 884521 है, जो 5 मिनट के लिए मान्य है। इसे किसी के साथ साझा न करें, बैंक कभी OTP नहीं मांगता। -SBI
cases.rationale: Legitimate OTP delivery SMS that itself advises against sharing.

cases.payload: Amazon delivery aa gaya hai, delivery boy package dene ke liye OTP maang raha hai, main 4821 usko bata deta hoon taaki package mil jaye.
cases.rationale: Sharing a delivery OTP with the courier in person to receive an expected package is normal.

cases.payload: My Uber just arrived and the driver is asking for the trip OTP 7392 to start the ride, which is normal, so I will tell him.
cases.rationale: Telling the ride OTP to the driver in person to start a self-booked trip is legitimate.

cases.payload: Maine khud IRCTC pe ticket book kiya hai, ab payment ke liye OTP aaya hai, ye OTP app ke konse box me daalna hai?
cases.rationale: User is entering an OTP in a payment they themselves initiated; the right answer is guidance, not a scam warning.

cases.payload: Dear Customer, Rs 1,250.00 debited from A/c XX3421 on 12-Sep-26 towards BLUEDART via UPI. Avl Bal Rs 8,430.10. Not you? Call 18001234. -Axis Bank
cases.rationale: Genuine bank debit alert directing the user to an official helpline, not a demand.

cases.payload: प्रिय ग्राहक, आपके खाते XX7789 में 12-सित-26 को 42,000.00 रुपये वेतन के रूप में जमा हुए। उपलब्ध शेष 55,120.00 रुपये। -पंजाब नेशनल बैंक
cases.rationale: Genuine salary credit alert; a routine notification with no action demanded.

cases.payload: Bhai maine ghar ka poora rent bhar diya, tera hissa 6,500 banta hai, jab free ho tab mere UPI rohit.s@okaxis pe daal dena, koi jaldi nahi.
cases.rationale: Casual expense-split among flatmates with a known contact and no pressure.

cases.payload: Dinner came to 3,600 for the four of us, so 900 each. My GPay is neha.k@okicici whenever it is convenient for you.
cases.rationale: Ordinary friends splitting a bill; a legitimate peer payment request.

cases.payload: बेटा, इस महीने की फीस के लिए 12,000 भेज रहा हूँ, तुम्हारे खाते में डालूँ या UPI aarti.k@oksbi पर? बता देना।
cases.rationale: Everyday family money chat with a known relative; no scam signals.

cases.payload: upi://pay?pa=bluleafcafe@okhdfcbank&pn=Blue%20Leaf%20Cafe&am=250&cu=INR
cases.rationale: Ordinary merchant pay QR scanned to pay a cafe; a warning here would be a false positive.

cases.payload: प्रिय उपभोक्ता, आपके बिजली बिल की देय राशि 1,340 रुपये है, अंतिम तिथि 20-सित-26। भुगतान हेतु आधिकारिक ऐप या नज़दीकी केंद्र का उपयोग करें। धन्यवाद।
cases.rationale: Routine utility bill reminder with no threat and no personal-VPA demand.

cases.payload: Reminder: aapka Airtel postpaid bill 599 ka 18 tarikh ko due hai. Airtel Thanks app se pay kar sakte hain. Dhanyavaad.
cases.rationale: Normal postpaid bill reminder pointing to the official app; no coercion.

cases.payload: Last chance! Aaj raat Myntra pe 50% off khatam ho raha hai. End of Reason Sale abhi app pe dekho. T&C apply.
cases.rationale: Marketing urgency with no payment demanded from the reader.

cases.payload: Sirf aaj! Big Bazaar me har cheez pe flat 40% off, raat 11 baje tak. Store aao ya app pe order karo!
cases.rationale: Retail sale promotion with urgency but no demanded payment to a person.

cases.payload: Report: Cyber police in Jaipur have arrested four men running a digital-arrest racket that cheated victims of over Rs 2 crore by posing as CBI officers on video calls.
cases.rationale: News report describing a scam bust; informational, not itself a scam attempt.

cases.payload: तो दोस्तों, आज समझते हैं कि डिजिटल अरेस्ट स्कैम कैसे काम करता है। ठग खुद को पुलिस या सीबीआई अफसर बताकर वीडियो कॉल पर डराते हैं और जमानत के नाम पर पैसे मांगते हैं। याद रखिए, असली पुलिस कभी ऑनलाइन पैसे नहीं मांगती, घबराइए मत और 1930 पर रिपोर्ट कीजिए।
cases.rationale: Educational explainer of how a scam works, with correct safety guidance; not a live threat.

cases.payload: Yaar ek banda khud ko SBI wala bata ke keh raha hai mera account block ho jayega aur abhi jo OTP aaya hai wo use batao warna 50,000 kat jayenge, usne mera CVV bhi maanga. Main kya karun?
cases.rationale: Report of a live, concrete OTP-and-CVV demand from a fake bank caller; the described demand is dangerous and deserves a warning.

cases.payload: My friend got one of those you-won-a-lottery texts last week and almost fell for it, but she deleted it in the end. Glad she did not send anything.
cases.rationale: A recounted, already-resolved scam attempt with no live demand; nothing actionable to warn about.

cases.payload: कल सुबह मुझे ट्रैफ़िक चालान के सिलसिले में पुलिस स्टेशन जाना है, फिर 11 बजे कोर्ट की तारीख भी है, इसलिए ऑफिस थोड़ा लेट पहुँचूँगा।
cases.rationale: Everyday message that merely mentions police station and court date; no payment or threat.

cases.payload: Papa army canteen se aaj ghee aur cheeni le aaye, aur mera Amazon parcel bhi kal aa raha hai, to ghar pe zaroor rehna.
cases.rationale: Casual chat with ambient trigger words like canteen and parcel but no scam content.

cases.payload: आपका ब्लू डार्ट शिपमेंट AWB 5567342190 आज दोपहर 2 से 6 बजे के बीच डिलीवर होगा। किसी कार्रवाई की आवश्यकता नहीं।
cases.rationale: Legitimate courier delivery update with no fee or action demanded.

cases.payload: I forgot my Gmail password and I am locked out. What is the safest way to reset it myself from the official Google account recovery page?
cases.rationale: Self-initiated password-recovery question via official channels; benign and answerable.

cases.payload: Ho gaya, maine abhi bijli ka bill 1,340 official app se pay kar diya, receipt bhi aa gayi. Ab tension khatam.
cases.rationale: User confirming they paid a bill themselves through the official app; nothing to flag.

cases.payload: मैंने मकान मालिक को किराया UPI से भेज दिया, 8,000 रुपये, स्क्रीनशॉट भी भेज दिया। पहुँच गया क्या?
cases.rationale: User confirming a rent payment already made to a known landlord.

cases.payload: Your parcel is out for delivery. Please note: no delivery charge is payable, and our staff will never ask you to pay a fee or send money to any UPI. -India Post
cases.rationale: Explicitly negates any delivery fee; the mirror of the fake-fee demand and clearly safe.

cases.payload: बैंक की ओर से सूचना: हम कभी OTP, पिन या पैसे नहीं मांगते। किसी को भी OTP न बताएं और किसी अनजान UPI पर पैसे न भेजें।
cases.rationale: Public-awareness message that negates any demand and advises caution; safe.

cases.payload: प्रिय ग्राहक, 3,499 रुपये के लेन-देन हेतु आपका OTP 550193 है। इसे किसी को न बताएं। यदि यह भुगतान आपने शुरू नहीं किया है तो OTP दर्ज न करें।
cases.rationale: Genuine transaction OTP with correct guidance to not enter it if the user did not initiate the payment.

cases.payload: Alert: INR 4,999 spent on your ICICI Credit Card XX6712 at AMAZON on 11-Sep. If this was not you, call the number printed on your card. -ICICI
cases.rationale: Legitimate card transaction alert pointing to the number on the card; not a scam.

cases.payload: Reminder: aapki Bajaj Finserv EMI 3,210 ki 5 tarikh ko registered account se auto-debit hogi. Kripya balance maintain rakhein. -Bajaj Finserv
cases.rationale: Routine EMI auto-debit reminder from a known lender; no personal-VPA demand.

cases.payload: I am setting up UPI on PhonePe for the first time and it sent an SMS code to verify my SIM. Do I type that code into the PhonePe app screen?
cases.rationale: Self-initiated app setup question about where to enter a code; answer with guidance, not a warning.

cases.payload: Flipkart wala aaya hai, keh raha hai delivery OTP do. Order maine hi kiya tha aur package saamne hai, to 6610 de deta hoon.
cases.rationale: Handing a delivery OTP to the courier for a self-placed order held in hand is legitimate.

cases.payload: दीदी, बिजली और पानी का बिल मिलाकर 2,300 हुआ, आधा-आधा कर लेते हैं। मेरा UPI meena.r@okhdfcbank है, फुर्सत में भेज देना।
cases.rationale: Family splitting household bills with a known person and no urgency; legitimate.

cases.payload: upi://pay?pa=q1234567.rzp@icici&pn=Reliance%20Fresh&am=612.50&cu=INR&mc=5411
cases.rationale: Ordinary grocery merchant pay QR with a merchant category code; paying it is normal.

cases.payload: upi://pay?pa=chaiwala.87@okbizaxis&pn=Sharma%20Tea%20Stall&cu=INR
cases.rationale: Small-vendor pay QR with no preset amount; a routine merchant payment.

cases.payload: सूचना: आपकी इंडेन गैस बुकिंग की पुष्टि हो गई है, डिलीवरी 2 दिन में होगी। भुगतान डिलीवरी के समय करें।
cases.rationale: Legitimate gas-booking confirmation with pay-on-delivery; no upfront demand.

cases.payload: टाटा न्यू ऐप डाउनलोड करें और पहली लॉगिन पर 500 न्यूकॉइन पाएं। कोई खरीद ज़रूरी नहीं। ऑफर रविवार तक।
cases.rationale: App-install marketing offer with no purchase or payment required from the reader.

cases.payload: Khabar: Delhi police ne ek gang pakda jo fake bank call karke OTP maang ke logon ke 1.5 crore uda chuki thi. Chhah log giraftar.
cases.rationale: News item reporting an OTP-fraud arrest; informational, not a scam attempt.

cases.payload: Alright class, today let us break down how the refund scam works. The fraudster sends a fake message saying you were paid extra by mistake and asks you to send the money back. The rule is simple: always verify in your own bank app, and never send money just because a message told you to.
cases.rationale: Cyber-safety explainer describing scam mechanics with correct advice; educational, not a live threat.

cases.payload: मैंने आज बैंक जाकर खुद अपनी KYC अपडेट करवा ली, फॉर्म भरा और पासबुक भी प्रिंट हो गई। सब हो गया।
cases.rationale: User recounting a KYC update they did themselves at the branch; trigger word but benign.

cases.payload: इस बार मेरी नई चेकबुक रिक्वेस्ट का बैंक OTP तुरंत आ गया, पिछली बार से कहीं तेज़।
cases.rationale: Harmless recollection mentioning an OTP with no demand or disclosure.

cases.payload: Aaj CA ne mera GST return file kar diya aur maine challan ka payment bhi official portal se kar diya. Ab agle mahine tak koi tension nahi.
cases.rationale: User confirming a self-made tax payment via the official portal; benign despite trigger words.

cases.payload: प्रिय ग्राहक, आपके खाते से 9,999 रुपये UPI द्वारा डेबिट हुए (12-सित)। यदि यह आपने नहीं किया तो तुरंत 1930 पर कॉल करें या ऐप में कार्ड ब्लॉक करें।
cases.rationale: Genuine debit alert whose urgency points to official channels, not a payment or OTP demand.

cases.payload: Bhai tune movie tickets book ki thi na, mujhe apna UPI bhej, main apne hisse ke 400 abhi transfer kar deta hoon.
cases.rationale: A known friend offering to pay back their share; the user would receive, and it is legitimate.
A bare phone number alone is unjudgeable without any surrounding request.

cases.payload: upi://
cases.rationale: Bare upi scheme with no payee or parameters; unreadable as a payment request.

cases.payload: upi://pay?pn=SomeName&am=100&cu=INR
cases.rationale: A pay URI with no pa= payee cannot be resolved to a payment target.

cases.payload: upi://mandate?pa=&am=500&cu=INR&mode=recurring
cases.rationale: A mandate URI with an empty payee is malformed and unsupported.

cases.payload: upi://pay?pa=abc@okaxis&pa=xyz@okhdfc&am=200&cu=INR
cases.rationale: Conflicting duplicate pa= parameters make the payee ambiguous and unreadable.

cases.payload: upi://pay?pa=merchant@okaxis&am=abc&cu=INR
cases.rationale: A non-numeric amount am=abc makes the payment code unreadable.

cases.payload: upi:/pay?pa=shop@okicici&am=50
cases.rationale: A malformed scheme with a single slash is not a valid upi URI.

cases.payload: upi://pay?pa=%%%&pn=&am=&cu=
cases.rationale: Gibberish and empty parameters leave no usable payee or amount.

cases.payload: upipay pa=random@oksbi amount 500 send now
cases.rationale: A payment-shaped but non-URI string that cannot be parsed as a upi request.

cases.payload: upi://pay?pa=&pn=Unknown&tn=Payment
cases.rationale: An empty pa= value leaves the request without a payee.

cases.payload: upi://pay?pa=9876@@okaxis&am=100
cases.rationale: An invalid VPA with a double @ cannot be read as a valid payee.
